notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.
